description: A pii-classification artifact maps every sensitive data field to its classification level, logging restrictions, encryption requirements, and applicable privacy jurisdictions.

rules.description: The manifest must declare a project name.
The fields array must contain at least one entry.
Each field entry must declare: id, entity, field_name, and classification_level.
classification_level must be one of: public, internal, sensitive, highly_sensitive.
Fields classified as highly_sensitive must declare encryption_key_ref and set storage_encrypted: true.
Fields classified as sensitive or highly_sensitive must declare a log_handling mode (mask, exclude, hash, truncate, or redact) and must not set log_in_plaintext: true.
Every field id (or entity.field_name combination) must be unique within the manifest.
Fields marked is_pii: true must declare a non-empty jurisdictions array using known values: gdpr, ccpa, hipaa, pipeda, lgpd, pdpa, global.
